RawClub

极简黑白粗野主义

布局结构

硬边分格导航 → 左超黑标题 / 右灰度建筑照片 → 四张项目列 → 表格化页脚

字体与视觉语言

极窄超黑字、等宽小字、蓝色下划线超链接；基本无圆角。

复刻要领

粗糙水泥建筑、黑白海报、集会现场、印刷字形照片。
链接、目录、项目列表、联系表单、页面分割线都使用真实 DOM。

根据原图反向重构的 Prompt（非历史原文）
Create an uncompromising editorial brutalist creative collective website called RAWCLUB. Architectural black-white split screen, huge compressed ultra-heavy black typography shouting “PEOPLE IDEAS IN PROGRESS.” with near-zero tracking, crisp hard grid lines and pure white background. Right half is high-grain documentary black-and-white photograph of raw concrete megastructure with hand-painted activist statement banner. Black header block logo “RAWCLUB”, numbered and underlined navigation resembling open web links, cobalt blue action button. Four raw monochrome project tiles below featuring urban statement photography, experimental letterform R, offline creative meetup in warehouse, printed makers directory. Pure graphic design brutalism, monospace captions, zero shadows and no rounded cards.
